name: databricks-sa-toolkit
purpose: Reusable Databricks Solution Architect Genie Code skill library
execution_model: UNDERSTAND -> DESIGN -> GENERATE CODE -> EXPLAIN -> STOP -> USER EXECUTES -> REVIEW RESULTS

skills.name: cloud-networking-review
skills.description: Review Databricks cloud networking and private-connectivity requirements including control/data plane boundaries, storage access, private endpoints, DNS, egress, firewall routing, and enterprise network integration.

skills.name: customer-discovery
skills.description: Turn an ambiguous customer problem into clear business objectives, stakeholders, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, data characteristics, assumptions, and high-value discovery questions before solution design.

skills.name: customer-meeting
skills.description: Prepare and structure a Databricks customer meeting such as discovery, architecture workshop, executive briefing, technical deep dive, security review, demo, PoC playback, or cost review.

skills.name: databricks-apps-integration
skills.description: Design a Databricks App as a user-facing solution component, including user workflow, app resources, authentication/authorization assumptions, backend integration, deployment plan, and generated application code when appropriate.

skills.name: demo-storytelling
skills.description: Design and rehearse a customer-facing Databricks prototype or product demonstration as a business story centered on personas, decisions, outcomes, architecture rationale, and next steps.

skills.name: genie-agent-integration
skills.description: Design a Databricks Genie Agent conversational analytics solution over governed data, including data-product readiness, business semantics, instructions, example questions, trusted logic, permissions, evaluation, and app/API integration when required.

skills.name: gold-analytical-modeling
skills.description: Design business-facing Gold facts, dimensions, aggregates, feature tables, or analytical data products with explicit grain, metric semantics, incremental behavior, and reconciliation, then generate SQL or PySpark code.

skills.name: persona-objection-handling
skills.description: Prepare or respond to customer objections and stakeholder challenges about Databricks architecture, cost, incumbent platforms, security, lock-in, scale, operations, adoption, or build-versus-buy.

skills.name: poc-design
skills.description: Design a focused Databricks proof of concept with a testable business hypothesis, narrow scope, measurable business and technical success criteria, dependencies, risks, and an explicit decision at completion.

skills.name: production-readiness-review
skills.description: Assess whether a Databricks prototype or solution is ready for production across correctness, security, reliability, performance, cost, observability, CI/CD, recovery, ownership, and support.

skills.name: prototype-planner
skills.description: Plan the smallest credible Databricks prototype needed to validate a customer hypothesis, decide what must work live versus be precomputed, mocked, or architecture-only, and route to technical specialist skills.

skills.name: sa-engagement-orchestrator
skills.description: Plan an end-to-end Databricks Solutions Architect customer engagement across discovery, architecture, prototype, demo, PoC, review, and next steps. Use when the user wants a complete engagement plan rather than one narrow technical task.

skills.name: security-governance-review
skills.description: Review a Databricks solution for identity, authorization, Unity Catalog governance, data classification, lineage, secrets, auditability, isolation, regulatory requirements, and secure data or AI access.

skills.name: silver-canonicalization
skills.description: Design trusted canonical Silver datasets and generate deterministic cleansing, deduplication, correction, delete, referential-integrity, and late-data handling code with reconciliation checks.

skills.name: solution-architecture
skills.description: Translate clarified business and technical requirements into a defensible Databricks solution architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, governance, serving, cloud integration, operations, alternatives, and trade-offs.

skills.name: solution-bootstrap
skills.description: Generate a minimal reproducible Databricks project and environment setup for a prototype or implementation, including setup scripts, structure, fallbacks, and verification commands, without silently changing the workspace.

skills.name: source-ingestion
skills.description: Select the appropriate Databricks ingestion pattern for files, event streams, reference extracts, snapshots, or change feeds and generate implementation and validation code for user execution.

skills.name: synthetic-data-generator
skills.description: Design realistic deterministic synthetic datasets and generate Python, PySpark, or SQL code for the user to execute for demos, functional validation, edge-case testing, or distributed Spark scale testing.

skills.name: validation-performance-review
skills.description: Validate Databricks data-processing correctness, review AI-generated Spark or SQL code, and diagnose performance using query plans and runtime evidence before generating targeted fixes.

skills.name: value-mapping
skills.description: Translate customer statements and pain points into business consequences, required capabilities, architecture decisions, Databricks positioning, measurable outcomes, and proof points.
